Góc $\widehat{A} = 180^\circ - (\widehat{B} + \widehat{C}) = 180^\circ - (56^\circ 13' + 71^\circ) = 52^\circ 47'$.
		Áp dụng định lí sin:
		$\displaystyle \frac{a}{\sin A} = \displaystyle \frac{c}{\sin C} \Rightarrow c = \displaystyle \frac{a \cdot \sin C}{\sin A} = \displaystyle \frac{16{,}8 \cdot \sin 71^\circ}{\sin 52^\circ 47'} \approx 19{,}9$.
